name: GigaAI
summary:
GigaAI develops embodied AI models, world-model tools and robot hardware as a connected system. Its Maker H01 platform combines a mobile base with two articulated arms, while GigaBrain provides decision-making and control and GigaWorld supports simulation and the generation of training data.

The company focuses on transferring learned capabilities across environments and robot configurations. Its development stack connects sensor inputs, task planning, motion planning and physical execution, with applications described in homes, commercial services, light industry and research. Open-source models and tools are part of its strategy for helping developers collect data, train policies and test robot behavior.
